command_path: the scripted command replaces the TCP command where stand_probe zeroes it, before the unchanged admission norm check; base_velocity term.commands, the post-step command parity and policy observation checks, metrics admitted_command, current_command.json applied/admitted command, the stance hold and the external finish dwell all use it; the TCP snapshot is still read and recorded as raw_command and command_stale/reason

script.name: walk_stop_start_stop_v1
script.note: PRD D5 (Dr Sun, 2026-09-17), forward only: 0-4 s zero; 4-7 s vx 0.6 m/s; 7-12 s zero; 12-14.5 s vx 0.6 m/s; 14.5 s onward zero. The stand launcher writes the finish request at 20 s. About 3.3 m commanded along the two-goal route corridor.

selection_rule: segment i applies from the first control step whose loop-top sim_time (Isaac time minus run_clock.simulation_origin_s, before wrapped.step) is at least t_start_s - 0.0001 s; metrics.jsonl rows record it as script_segment
